summary: Backend-only regression for the Meal Muster follow-up fixes (mark-bulk eligibility guard + test restore fix + _ensure_meal_index removal). Created new focused test file test_meal_mark_bulk_eligibility.py with 8 tests covering: meal-ineligible-category skip, ex-member skip (leaving_date < meal_date), final active day allow (leaving_date == meal_date), 3-way mixed batch, admin-role skip regression, duplicate-key idempotency, empty user_ids regression, and meal_records unique-index presence via direct pymongo. All 8 new tests + 11 existing roster tests + 18 test_meal_muster tests + 8 test_meals.py tests = 45 tests PASSED. The MEDIUM race window is closed, the test-restore LOW is verified (finally blocks now restore observed value), and the perf LOW (index no longer built per-request) is verified via mongo_db.meal_records.index_information() showing uniq_user_date_meal is unique on (user_id,date,meal).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: mark-bulk hydrates users via {'id': {'$in': body.user_ids}} without also filtering role/leaving_date/category in the DB query. For batches of thousands, pushing predicates into Mongo (like the roster endpoint does) would avoid pulling ineligible docs across the wire. Not a correctness issue.

Minor: /api/members Pydantic accepts only 5 seeded category Literals. That's the correct behavior for member creation, but it means the mixed-batch test had to reuse the executive seed category (toggled off) instead of a bespoke throwaway. Documented in the test comment.
seed_data_creation: All test members and category flips are created and cleaned up in finally blocks (delete member, unmark records, restore category.meal_eligible to observed pre-test value).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Meal Muster mark-bulk now enforces eligibility on write. If further changes touch /api/meals/mark-bulk, /api/meals/roster, or services/permissions.is_ex_member, re-run: pytest tests/test_meal_mark_bulk_eligibility.py tests/test_meal_roster_ex_member_and_eligibility.py tests/test_meal_muster.py tests/test_meals.py
